# coolify_cloud_init_script (Data Source)

Reads a Coolify cloud-init script by UUID. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_cloud_init_script" "bootstrap" {
  uuid = coolify_cloud_init_script.bootstrap.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) Script UUID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Script name.
- `script` (String, Sensitive) Script body when the token can read it.
